reviews.review:
For those of you that speak English, here's how you're gonna play:

**Make sure you open the client through STEAM, otherwise you get a somethingsomethingSTEAMsomethingsomething error!**
Once the client is open, the top-left chinese text button will open the browser registration. Forms are this, in order: email, username, password, confirm password, real name, ID # / display name / just make it the same as your username, confirm captcha. Make sure the check box is checked to accept the user agreement and click your big yellow button. If you get a popup it should be a confirmation.

Back in the client, select the only (current) server (purple button) and then the left of the bottom blue buttons to connect. Double-clicking the server (purple) button also seems to have the same effect. The right blue button cancels and returns to the main launcher screen, where if you click the big blue button it'll throw the steam error. At this point I was unable to connect (it just kept loading) but someone else I know was able to get through, so maybe you will, too. I can't help you much past here, since it won't load, but if you make it this far I believe in you! Good luck!

Update: 1/7/17:
After downloading the game from their website as opposed to Steam, I was able to get in and play a few matches, so for those of you that can get through to the main game I can help you out a little more.

Once logged in and loaded into the client (ready to play), you can find a PvP match (I'm pretty sure it is) with the top left blue button that has little people on it (in the row of blue buttons near the top). I don't know what the second blue button is, but the third is private games, and I believe the fourth is Co-op vs AI.

You can collect daily rewards and challenge completion rewards by clicking the store bag (little golden bag, top right corner) whenever it has a red dot on it. The next button, which is two little people, is your friends list.

When you're in a lobby, the golden button will take you into queue. When you're in character select, the small blue button next to your team's pick portraits will lock in your pick.

Hopefully that's enough to get you into a game! I've played a few games and only have 500ms from the East Coast, I'm not sure if the enemies are AI or just bad because I get about 30 kills a game and they have 0 coordination, but I've just hit level 8~ and the game is pretty fun. Would reccommend !
